entries.5133dfa8ce256ad4: This segment undertakes building construction works using PC technology, including planning, design and construction supervision, and manufactures and sells PC building products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,084 million. It handles precast products for condominiums and seismic reinforcement works, among others.
entries.5e80ab9b68bfb93b: This segment undertakes civil engineering works using PC technology, including planning, design and construction supervision, and manufactures and sells PC civil engineering products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥23,053 million. It focuses on large-scale works such as bridges, and Suruga Giken Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, diagnoses and repairs and reinforces concrete structures.
entries.8a894b41b6a0207b: The company is headquartered in Chuo-ku, Fukuoka, and its main business is construction using PC (prestressed concrete) technology. The company, three subsidiaries and one other affiliated company form the group, and consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 numbered 491. The company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange and the Fukuoka Stock Exchange.
entries.8c7daf8c34b73868: A construction company headquartered in Fukuoka City that undertakes civil engineering and building work using PC (prestressed concrete) technology and manufactures and sells PC products.
entries.9c033092c76170f9: This is a business not included in reportable segments and includes real estate leasing and management, overseas operations and construction equipment leasing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥92 million. Real estate leasing, which was a reportable segment previously, has been included in this category from the current fiscal year.
entries.ac5f0b0b0237c2a2: Government agencies (Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism and local governments)
entries.b8a769a9676c2763: A consolidated subsidiary headquartered in Shizuoka City, Shizuoka Prefecture, which diagnoses and repairs and reinforces concrete structures such as bridges.
